LA as in Los Angeles... where the worst kind of driving happens? 😛
I ran on it for one day, local roads. Handles pretty good, didn’t feel any difference - which in a way is good because it’s a change that doesn’t bring regression.
La is the first model since NG that can keep the car between lanes. At least for me. I love it

Yes. The whole point of these recent models are to replace more and more hard code with a model that just knows what to do
No more hard coded lateral planner needed because they've taught the model how to plan for itself
